scripts.check:all: node --input-type=module -e "import { execFileSync, spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; const files = [...new Set(execFileSync('git', ['ls-files', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '-z']).toString().split('\0').filter((file) => file.endsWith('.check.mjs')))].sort(); let count = 0; for (const file of files) { console.log(); console.log('> ' + file); const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, [file], { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (result.error) throw result.error; if (result.status !== 0) process.exit(result.status ?? 1); count++; } const pythonCheck = 'alpaca-bot-bridge/supervise-tunnel.check.py'; console.log(); console.log('> ' + pythonCheck); const python = spawnSync('python3', ['-B', pythonCheck], { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (python.error) throw python.error; if (python.status !== 0) process.exit(python.status ?? 1); console.log(); console.log('All ' + count + ' JavaScript checks and 1 Python check passed.');"
